# Craft Beer School

> Craft Beer School is an India-based beer school teaching brewing, tasting, branding and the business of beer, online and in person. Based in Bengaluru, serving learners across India and worldwide.

## Courses

- [Brewing Fundamentals](https://craftbeerschool.in/brewing-fundamentals-course.html): The science of brewing: ingredients, equipment and technique. Live online sessions, plus your first real recipe. Duration 4 Weeks. Price INR 5999.
- [Advanced Brewing Science](https://craftbeerschool.in/advanced-brewing-science-course.html): Go deeper into brewing chemistry, microbiology and fermentation. For serious homebrewers and professionals. Duration 6 Weeks. Price INR 12999.
- [Brewery Business Management](https://craftbeerschool.in/brewery-business-management-course.html): The business behind the brew: plan, launch and grow a brewery, from finance to distribution. Duration 3 Weeks. Price INR 8999.
- [Style Specialisation](https://craftbeerschool.in/style-specialization-course.html): Master IPAs, stouts, lagers, sours and Belgian ales: their history, technique and award-winning examples. Duration 8 Weeks. Price INR 18999.
- [Beer Branding and Packaging](https://craftbeerschool.in/beer-branding-packaging-course.html): Build a beer brand that stands out and packaging that sells. Made for aspiring brewers and founders. Duration 3 Weeks. Price INR 4999.
- [Sensory Evaluation](https://craftbeerschool.in/sensory-evaluation-course.html): Train your palate like a pro: taste, identify off-flavours and score beer with real sensory methods. Duration 2 Weeks. Price INR 5999.
- [AI for Craft Breweries](https://craftbeerschool.in/ai-for-craft-breweries-course.html): Put GenAI to work on your brewery's copy, social posts and weekly admin and use it responsibly. No coding needed. Duration 2 Weeks. Price INR 5000.
- [Digital Transformation Basics for Brewing](https://craftbeerschool.in/digital-transformation-basics-for-brewing-course.html): Move your brewery off paper and into simple digital tools: brew logs, stock, batch tracking and a dashboard you will actually open. Duration 2 Weeks. Price INR 5000.
- [ESG in Craft Brewing](https://craftbeerschool.in/esg-in-craft-brewing-course.html): Water, energy, spent grain, packaging, people and governance: measure what your brewery does and tell the story honestly. Duration 2 Weeks. Price INR 5000.
- [Safety in Brewing](https://craftbeerschool.in/safety-in-brewing-course.html): The hazards that hurt people in breweries and how to work around them: CO2, chemicals, heat, pressure and confined spaces. Duration 1 Week. Free (price INR 0).
- [Craft Distilling](https://craftbeerschool.in/craft-distilling-course.html): From wash to bottle: stills, cuts, gin botanicals, ageing in Indian heat and the licences a craft distillery needs. Duration 4 Weeks. Price INR 9999.
- [Craft Gin Making](https://craftbeerschool.in/craft-gin-making-course.html): Design and make a gin of your own: juniper and botanicals, the still run, proofing and getting a bottle to market in India. Duration 4 Weeks. Price INR 9999.
- [RTD Drinks: Alcoholic and Non-Alcoholic](https://craftbeerschool.in/rtd-drinks-alcoholic-and-non-alcoholic-course.html): Ready-to-drink cans and bottles, with and without alcohol: formulation, sweetness and acid, carbonation, shelf life and the rules. Duration 2 Weeks. Price INR 5000.
- [Hop Water](https://craftbeerschool.in/hop-water-course.html): Sparkling water with all the aroma of hops and none of the alcohol. Make it on brewery kit and keep it stable on the shelf. Duration 2 Weeks. Price INR 5000.
- [Hard Seltzer](https://craftbeerschool.in/hard-seltzer-course.html): A clean, dry sugar ferment turned into a light, fruity seltzer: base, yeast nutrition, clarity, flavour and the rules in India. Duration 2 Weeks. Price INR 5000.
- [Kombucha](https://craftbeerschool.in/kombucha-course.html): Brew kombucha safely and consistently, from tea, sugar and culture to flavoured, sparkling bottles for a cafe or taproom. Duration 2 Weeks. Price INR 5000.
- [Non-Alcoholic Beer](https://craftbeerschool.in/non-alcoholic-beer-course.html): Beer that still tastes like beer, without the alcohol: limited fermentation, special yeasts, body and aroma, plus keeping it safe on the shelf. Duration 2 Weeks. Price INR 5000.
- [Power BI and Tableau for Breweries](https://craftbeerschool.in/power-bi-and-tableau-for-breweries-course.html): Build the dashboards a brewery actually opens: brew logs, yield, losses, stock and sales in Power BI or Tableau, from your own spreadsheets. Duration 2 Weeks. Price INR 5000.
- [Winemaking](https://craftbeerschool.in/winemaking-course.html): Grape to bottle: harvest numbers, crushing and pressing, red and white fermentation, malolactic, clarifying and bottling, for Indian vineyards and climate. Duration 2 Weeks. Price INR 5000.
- [Fortified Wine](https://craftbeerschool.in/fortified-wine-course.html): How port-style, sherry-style and other fortified wines are made: fortifying with grape spirit, sweetness, oxidative ageing and blending. Duration 2 Weeks. Price INR 5000.
- [Winery Business](https://craftbeerschool.in/winery-business-course.html): Run a small winery as a business: costing a bottle, licences and excise, route to market, cellar door and wine tourism in India. Duration 2 Weeks. Price INR 5000.
- [New Product Development: Beer, Whisky and Wine](https://craftbeerschool.in/new-product-development-beer-whisky-and-wine-course.html): Take a new beer, whisky or wine from idea to launch: consumer insight, formulation, pilot batches, sensory testing, costing, labels and launch. Duration 2 Weeks. Price INR 5000.
- [Digital Marketing for Breweries](https://craftbeerschool.in/digital-marketing-for-breweries-course.html): Market a brewery online inside India's alcohol advertising rules: Instagram, WhatsApp, Google listings and content that fills a taproom. Duration 2 Weeks. Price INR 5000.
- [Brand Strategy and Positioning for Breweries](https://craftbeerschool.in/brand-strategy-and-positioning-for-breweries-course.html): Work out who your brewery is for and why it is different, then write it down so every label, post and pint says the same thing. Duration 2 Weeks. Price INR 5000.
- [Rebranding a Brewery](https://craftbeerschool.in/rebranding-a-brewery-course.html): Plan a rebrand that keeps the drinkers you have: audit, goals, budget, the design brief and a roll-out timed to new labels and approvals. Duration 2 Weeks. Price INR 5000.
- [Naming and Trademarks for Drinks Brands](https://craftbeerschool.in/naming-and-trademarks-for-drinks-brands-course.html): Find a brewery or beer name people can say, spell and remember, then check it is free to use before you print a single label. Duration 2 Weeks. Price INR 5000.
- [Taproom Marketing and Community](https://craftbeerschool.in/taproom-marketing-and-community-course.html): Turn first visits into regulars: events, beer clubs, staff who live the brand and local partnerships for a taproom or brewpub. Duration 2 Weeks. Price INR 5000.

## Guides

- [A bottling day checklist for homebrewers](https://craftbeerschool.in/a-bottling-day-checklist-for-homebrewers.html): A step by step bottling day checklist: when the beer is ready, how much priming sugar, sanitising, filling, capping and conditioning in Indian heat.
- [A brewery design review before you sign the equipment order](https://craftbeerschool.in/a-brewery-design-review-before-you-sign-the-equipment-order.html): What a design review checks before an Indian brewery signs its equipment order: tank capacity, glycol in Indian heat, drainage, utilities and excise needs.
- [A career as a brewery maintenance engineer](https://craftbeerschool.in/a-career-as-a-brewery-maintenance-engineer.html): What brewery maintenance engineers do, the skills and qualifications they need, how to get in and where the role can lead in India.
- [A career in beer marketing and brand management](https://craftbeerschool.in/a-career-in-beer-marketing-and-brand-management.html): What beer marketing and brand management jobs involve in India, the skills they need, how alcohol ad rules shape the work and how to get in.
- [A cleaning and CIP audit when beer keeps getting infected](https://craftbeerschool.in/a-cleaning-and-cip-audit-when-beer-keeps-getting-infected.html): How to audit cleaning and CIP when beer keeps getting infected: trace the pattern, check time, temperature and chemical strength and find where bacteria hide.
- [A draught system audit for foamy pours and flat beer at the bar](https://craftbeerschool.in/a-draught-system-audit-for-foamy-pours-and-flat-beer-at-the.html): How to audit a draught system when beer pours foamy or flat: temperature, gas pressure, line balance, cleaning and glassware, with the numbers to check.
- [A first pale ale recipe for a 10 litre homebrew batch](https://craftbeerschool.in/a-first-pale-ale-recipe-for-a-10-litre-homebrew-batch.html): A tested 10 litre all grain pale ale recipe with grain weights, hop schedule, mash temperature, fermentation and the numbers to expect.
- [A LinkedIn profile that gets brewers noticed by recruiters](https://craftbeerschool.in/a-linkedin-profile-that-gets-brewers-noticed-by-recruiters.html): How brewers and aspiring brewers can build a LinkedIn profile recruiters find: headline, about section, experience, skills and keywords.
- [A simple beer tasting sheet for beginners with a free template](https://craftbeerschool.in/a-simple-beer-tasting-sheet-for-beginners-with-a-free.html): A free, one page beer tasting sheet for beginners, with what to write in each box and how to use it to train your palate.
- [A simple cleaning routine for the hours after brew day](https://craftbeerschool.in/a-simple-cleaning-routine-for-the-hours-after-brew-day.html): What to clean after brew day, in what order and with what: kettle, bag, chiller and fermenter, plus spent grain and how to store kit dry.
- [A ten minute daily taste panel for a small brewpub team](https://craftbeerschool.in/a-ten-minute-daily-taste-panel-for-a-small-brewpub-team.html): Set up a ten minute daily taste panel in a small brewpub: who tastes, what, when, the form to use and how to act on the results.
- [A water treatment audit for breweries on borewell or tanker water](https://craftbeerschool.in/a-water-treatment-audit-for-breweries-on-borewell-or-tanker.html): How to audit water treatment in an Indian brewery on borewell or tanker water: what to test, RO and carbon checks and keeping brewing water consistent.
- [ABV, Plato and original gravity explained for analysts](https://craftbeerschool.in/abv-plato-and-original-gravity-explained-for-analysts.html): What ABV, degrees Plato and original gravity mean, how they connect and why they matter for the numbers analysts see in brewery dashboards.
- [Acid washing yeast and when it does more harm than good](https://craftbeerschool.in/acid-washing-yeast-and-when-it-does-more-harm-than-good.html): How acid washing yeast works, the pH, temperature and timing that keep it safe plus the slurries you should never wash.
- [Adding a sour or barrel programme without infecting the brewery](https://craftbeerschool.in/adding-a-sour-or-barrel-programme-without-infecting-the.html): How to add kettle sours, mixed fermentation or barrel ageing to an Indian brewery without spreading Brettanomyces or bacteria into your clean beers.
- [Adding coffee to beer](https://craftbeerschool.in/adding-coffee-to-beer.html): How to add coffee to homebrew: cold brew versus whole beans, how much to use, which beer to put it in and how to keep the aroma fresh without bitterness.
- [Adding Indian honey to beer without losing its aroma](https://craftbeerschool.in/adding-indian-honey-to-beer.html): How to brew with Indian honey without fermenting away its aroma: how much to use, when to add it, gravity maths and which honeys work best in beer.
- [Adding spirits, wine and cocktails to a brewpub bar licence](https://craftbeerschool.in/adding-spirits-wine-and-cocktails-to-a-brewpub-bar-licence.html): What it takes to add spirits, wine and cocktails to an Indian brewpub: licence steps, stock records, bar set-up and the margin trade-offs.
- [Adding water to whisky: how much, when and why it changes the flavour](https://craftbeerschool.in/adding-water-to-whisky.html): Why a few drops of water can open up a whisky's aroma, how much to add, which water to use and when ice helps or hurts the flavour.
- [American ale yeast strains compared for a clean, dry IPA](https://craftbeerschool.in/american-ale-yeast-strains-compared.html): Chico, West Coast dry strains and fast San Diego types compared for a clean, dry IPA: attenuation, flocculation, esters and what suits an Indian brewpub.
- [Annual licence renewals for Indian breweries and how to plan them](https://craftbeerschool.in/annual-licence-renewals-for-indian-breweries-and-how-to-plan.html): How Indian breweries can plan annual licence renewals: building a compliance calendar, documents to prepare and lead times to allow.
- [Are electric all-in-one brewing systems worth the money?](https://craftbeerschool.in/are-electric-all-in-one-brewing-systems-worth-the-money.html): An honest look at electric all-in-one brewing systems for Indian homebrewers: what they do well, power and plug needs and when a bag and pot is enough.
- [Rice lagers of Asia compared from Japan to Thailand and India](https://craftbeerschool.in/asian-rice-lagers-compared.html): How rice lagers from Japan, Thailand, Vietnam, China and India differ, why brewers use rice and what to look for when you taste them side by side.
- [Astringency in beer and why it can feel like stewed tea](https://craftbeerschool.in/astringency-in-beer-and-why-it-can-feel-like-stewed-tea.html): What astringency in beer is, why it feels like over-brewed tea and the brewing habits that cause it, from hot sparging to heavy dry hopping.
- [ATP swabs for quick hygiene checks in a small brewery](https://craftbeerschool.in/atp-swabs-for-quick-hygiene-checks-in-a-small-brewery.html): How ATP swabs work, what the RLU number means, where to swab in a small brewery and how to set your own pass and fail limits.
- [Auditing a small brewery's can and bottle packaging line](https://craftbeerschool.in/auditing-a-small-brewerys-can-and-bottle-packaging-line.html): How to audit a small brewery's canning or bottling line: oxygen pickup, fill levels, seams and crowns, losses and the numbers worth logging.
- [What to write on the back of a beer can and what to leave off](https://craftbeerschool.in/back-of-can-copywriting.html): How to plan the back panel of a beer can in India: the legal lines first, then the words that help a shopper pick your beer, then what to cut.
- [Bank loans for a brewery in India and what lenders ask for](https://craftbeerschool.in/bank-loans-for-a-brewery-in-india-and-what-lenders-ask-for.html): What Indian banks typically ask for when you apply for a brewery or brewpub loan: the project report, margin money, security and approvals.
- [Barley and malt for procurement teams](https://craftbeerschool.in/barley-and-malt-for-procurement-teams.html): What procurement teams need to know about barley, malt specs, crop years, storage and why price per tonne is the wrong number to compare.
- [Barleywine or imperial stout for ageing at home in India](https://craftbeerschool.in/barleywine-vs-imperial-stout-for-ageing.html): Which strong beer rewards a year in an Indian cupboard: barleywine or imperial stout? How each one changes, what storage they need and how to taste the result.
- [Becoming a beer trainer or educator in India](https://craftbeerschool.in/becoming-a-beer-trainer-or-educator-in-india.html): How to become a beer trainer or educator in India: the knowledge you need, certifications to consider, where the work is and how to start.
- [Becoming a whisky brand ambassador in India: skills and first steps](https://craftbeerschool.in/becoming-a-whisky-brand-ambassador-india.html): What a whisky brand ambassador does in India, the skills and knowledge the job needs and practical first steps for career changers.

## Facts

- Format: live online sessions plus hands-on in-person brewery workshops.
- Online schedule: Saturdays and Sundays, 12:00 PM to 2:00 PM IST, max 20 students per batch.
- Certificate of Completion needs all assignments and at least 80% attendance.
- Certification support: WSET and Cicerone preparation.
- Cohorts are deliberately small, with one-to-one mentorship.
- Contact: chatty@cheerschattyventures.com, +91-98209-25347.
